head_commit.message:
sprint 2 begin: AARO ingestion, error-reporting, public-launch infrastructure

Repo flipped to public. GitHub Pages enabled with workflow source.
First Pages build triggers on this push: site goes live at
  https://omgitzyeoku-collab.github.io/UFO/

AARO ingestion (Sprint 2 first slice):
  extract/build-aaro-manifest.mjs  — pulls 35 unique aaro.mil PDFs
  from existing crawl manifests (already on disk from earlier
  multi-domain crawl), appends to extract/release-manifest.jsonl with
  source:"aaro.mil". All have OCR text already extracted.
  Notable AARO docs now in corpus:
    AARO PIA Section 1
    AARO Al Taqaddam Case Resolution
    Mt Etna Object
    AARO Puerto Rico UAP Case Resolution
    AARO GoFast Case Resolution Methodology
    Atmospheric Wakes Case Resolution
    Eglin UAP-2 Case Resolution
    Southeast Asia Triangles Case Resolution
    (and 27 more)

Corpus is now 178 unique items: 143 war.gov + 35 AARO. QA pipeline
restarted over expanded set (idempotent — skips the 6 already done,
queues remaining 172).

Error-reporting + corrections (zero-error mandate):
  .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/correction.yml  — structured correction form
  .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/missing.yml     — missing-source form
  public/corrections.html                — public append-only log page
  Each doc card on the public site now has a one-click "report an
  error" link that pre-fills the GitHub issue with the doc's title.

SEO + discovery:
  public/robots.txt
  public/sitemap.xml (148 URLs, regenerated by extract/generate-sitemap.mjs)
  Open Graph meta on every page

Monetisation scaffolding:
  .github/FUNDING.yml — GitHub Sponsors + Open Collective + Ko-fi +
    Buy Me a Coffee + custom URL fields, all placeholders for the
    user to populate when accounts are set up.

Public dashboard (public/index.html):
  - Now renders source badge for non-war.gov docs (AARO etc.)
  - AARO agency colour (--AARO #34d399)
  - Modal detail panel includes "report an error" link
  - Source attribution on doc-detail meta line

Brand pre-committed: "UAP Files" (recommended #1 from the three
options). Domain pending user pick (uapfiles.org / uapfiles.eu /
uap-files.org). For now, site lives at the github.io subdomain.

head_commit.message:
sprint 1: 5-agent QA pipeline + public dashboard for monetised public launch

Reframed for new brief: free public archive, donation-supported, zero
error tolerance, first-to-market across all gov UAP sources.

5-agent QA pipeline (extract/qa-pipeline.mjs):
  Agent A (EXTRACTOR)     pulls structured facts from source
  Agent B (VERIFIER)      independent fresh-context check, ✓/✗ per claim
  Agent C (ADJUDICATOR)   resolves disagreements via re-read
  Step  D (CITATION)      deterministic source-text quote matching
  Agent E (REWRITER)      plain-English prose using ONLY verified facts

Confidence tiers:
  green  = A+B agree, citation found in source
  amber  = A+B agree, partial citation (hedged language)
  red    = adjudication failed, hidden from public

Sample output verified on FBI 62-HQ-83894 Section 10:
  Headline: "New Hampshire Woman Asked FBI if UFO Club Was Communist"
  Pipeline correctly identified Mrs. Florence C. Dow's 1966 letter to
  J. Edgar Hoover from a heavily OCR-noisy scan. Distinguished factual
  FBI form-letter response from unverified AFSCA newsletter "Korendor"
  alien-contact claims. Wrote neutral plain-English narrative with
  5 explicit caveats including OCR quality warning.

Public dashboard (public/index.html):
  - News-card layout, mobile-responsive
  - Confidence tier badges per doc (verified / partial / awaiting QA)
  - Modal detail view with inline pdf.js viewer + video player
  - Key facts box with green/amber confidence per claim
  - "What to know" caveats prominently displayed
  - Citable deep links via #doc/<sha256>
  - Filter by agency / tier / sort

Static pages:
  public/about.html         — what this is, what it isn't
  public/methodology.html   — full QA pipeline explained for audit
  public/donate.html        — donation rails (placeholders)

Deployment:
  .github/workflows/pages.yml updated to deploy /public/ as site root

Status: QA pipeline running over 141 corpus items in background.
~6 hours to complete. Sprint 1 ships when QA finishes + user picks
brand/domain + repo flips public.

docs/sprint-1-status.md tracks brand/domain/monetisation decisions
needed from user before Sprint 1 closes.

head_commit.message:
release: +28 DVIDS videos, OCR complete on all 65 scanned PDFs

Acquisition is now genuinely complete (all 158 unique items in the
war.gov/UFO/ CSV plus the 130 thumbnails). Release inventory:

  PDFs:        116
  MP4 videos:   28  (newly acquired)
  Tarball:       1  (thumbnails.tar.gz)
  TOTAL:       145 assets, 3.57 GB

DVIDS pipeline (crawler/dvids-videos.mjs) discovers MP4 URLs via the
DVIDS page HTML (CloudFront-served, no auth). Idempotent + resumable
with sha256 dedup. Largest video: 189 MB (Greece Oct 2023). Smallest:
0.4 MB (Syria Oct 2024).

scripts/publish-videos.mjs uploads each MP4 to the existing release
v1.0-release-01-mirror as a named asset (dvids-{ID}-{title-slug}.mp4)
and appends to extract/release-manifest.jsonl with sha256 + DVIDS id +
release URL.

OCR completed in 121 minutes (pymupdf renders to PNG, tesseract.js
WASM does the OCR). All 65 scanned PDFs now have text in
extract/text/<sha>.txt — the full FBI 62-HQ-83894 case file, NARA box-186
1949 flying-discs, German armament 1944-45, intel collection 1948-55, etc.
Quality varies (heavy redaction + degraded scans), but the corpus is no
longer text-blind.

Other artefacts in this commit:

  docs/next-phase-plan.md      Strategic plan for hypothesis-driven
                               analysis, public publication, longitudinal
                               tranche handling. Three workstreams,
                               5 items each, with effort estimates.
  scripts/publish-videos.mjs   The video upload pipeline.
  crawler/dvids-videos.mjs     The DVIDS acquisition pipeline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
